guitar.evidence: Joan Baez has long played Martin acoustic guitars (notably a Martin 0-45), well documented in folk circles though not as singularly iconic as e.g. Dylan's gear.

tone.summary: Clean, warm acoustic tone using a clean preamp and US Deluxe/US 2x12 setup, enhanced with room reverb for intimate clarity.
corrections: Use acoustic sim not electric amp
Prioritize body resonance over electric sheen

rig.name: Joan Baez - Diamonds And Rust - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean recordings.

blocks.purpose: Smooth out dynamics and add warmth to the acoustic signal.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 lacks a dedicated Acoustic Preamp. Compression is used to emulate the smooth, controlled sound of a high-quality piezo/acoustic pickup.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No distortion or overdrive is required for a clean acoustic sound.
Provide a clean, warm, and non-aggressive tone suitable for folk ballads.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the closest available model to simulate the body resonance of an acoustic guitar without adding electric grit. Settings are dialed back significantly.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the close-mic warmth and focused sound of a small studio acoustic recording setup.
blocks.gap: While not an acoustic cab, the US 2x12 provides a clean, articulate voicing that suits fingerpicking clarity better than larger cabs.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the body resonance (low-mids) and maintain clarity without sounding harsh.
blocks.gap: Used to sculpt the frequency response, compensating for the lack of dedicated acoustic EQ controls. Focus is on warmth and definition.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No filtering or wah effect is appropriate for this intimate style.
Bypass. Modulation effects (Chorus/Tremolo) would distract from the natural acoustic sound.
Bypass. Long delays are explicitly avoided to maintain intimacy and natural sound.
Add natural room ambience and depth, simulating a studio recording environment.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is chosen over Plate/Spring for its natural, non-metallic decay that best suits folk music.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic cabinet simulation with a dedicated acoustic IR/cab model to enhance realism.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Studio Acoustic Cab IR (e.g., Neumann U87)
proposals.reason: US 2x12 is too electric; needs a dedicated acoustic mic/cab for realism.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased natural body resonance and clarity.
